name: Replicate - H200 GPU instance
price_basis: per H200 GPU-hour, on-demand, including 13 vCPU + 144 GB RAM. Fetched 2026-10-04. Per-second billing at $0.001525/sec. NOTE: H200 capacity requires committed spend contracts.
notes: Replicate H200 at $5.49/hr is the same price as their H100, which is notable - the H200 has 141GB HBM3e memory vs the H100's 80GB, so the H200 offers more memory at the same price. However, the H200 tier requires a committed spend contract, so it is not a walk-in rate. This is below CoreWeave on-demand H200 ($6.31) but above Together AI's on-demand H200 ($5.99).
